label: Bible Study
prompt: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had _____ on him,
verse: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
note: The Good Samaritan — the outsider was the one who stopped to help.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the _____ heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:
verse: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:
note: A heart transplant: out goes the stony heart, in comes a heart of flesh.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a _____ of oil.
verse: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.
note: Elisha asked the widow what she had in the house: just a pot of oil — which was all the miracle needed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: O _____ man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
verse: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
note: Paul's cry from the tug-of-war within — answered one verse later: 'I thank God through Jesus Christ.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that _____ his lips is wise.
verse: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.
note: More words, more chances to sin — so the wise man 'refraineth his lips.' James 1:19 says the same: slow to speak.
